name: bug
description: Something is broken or behaving incorrectly.

name: enhancement
description: Requested improvement or new capability.

name: documentation
description: Improvements or additions to documentation.

name: needs-info
description: Issue: waiting on the reporter for details needed to act on it.

name: size:XS
description: Under 30 changed lines, tests excluded. No automatic AI review.

name: size:S
description: 30-149 changed lines, tests excluded.

name: size:M
description: 150-499 changed lines, tests excluded.

name: size:L
description: 500-1,499 changed lines, tests excluded.

name: size:XL
description: 1,500-2,999 changed lines, tests excluded. Gets the deeper AI review.

name: size:XXL
description: 3,000+ changed lines, tests excluded. Deeper AI review; consider splitting.

name: priority:P0
description: Drop everything: breaks a release, loses work or a security hole.

name: priority:P1
description: On the current top 3: reliability, self-installing updates, a new user finishing a reel unaided.

name: priority:P2
description: Next up: the near-term quality list and first-run polish.

name: priority:P3
description: Later: worth doing, waits behind everything above.

name: type:feat
description: Set from the PR title: a new capability.

name: type:fix
description: Set from the PR title: a bug fix.

name: type:perf
description: Set from the PR title: faster or lighter.

name: type:refactor
description: Set from the PR title: same behavior, better code.

name: type:docs
description: Set from the PR title: documentation only.

name: type:test
description: Set from the PR title: tests only.

name: type:build
description: Set from the PR title: packaging, dependencies or the build.

name: type:ci
description: Set from the PR title: workflows and repo tooling.

name: type:chore
description: Set from the PR title: upkeep that changes nothing a user sees.

name: type:revert
description: Set from the PR title: undoes an earlier change.

name: area:app
description: Set from changed files: the desktop app (app/).

name: area:ai
description: Set from changed files: the AI editor (ai/).

name: area:engine
description: Set from changed files: the render engine (engine/).

name: area:templates
description: Set from changed files: animation templates (templates/).

name: area:packaging
description: Set from changed files: installers, signing and icons (packaging/).

name: area:docs
description: Set from changed files: docs/ and top-level Markdown.

name: area:ci
description: Set from changed files: .github/ and scripts/.
